description: React component for a trainer's program builder interface in a gym management system. It manages templates, clients, and programs, allowing creation and generation of workout days.

methods.name: ProgramBuilder
methods.description: Main React functional component for building workout programs, managing state, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: loadTemplates
methods.description: Fetches workout templates from the API.

methods.name: loadClients
methods.description: Fetches clients associated with the trainer.

methods.name: loadProgramsForMember
methods.description: Fetches existing programs for a selected member.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a new workout program based on user input.

methods.name: generateDays
methods.description: Generates workout days for a program, either automatically or within a date range.
